title: Class-group factor bases
objective: Implement and optimize exact Minkowski, Bach, and BDF factor-base planning, compact authenticated records, resumable norm streaming, and selective prime-ideal construction with focused cross-oracle and performance tests

handoff.summary: Implements rational-interval-certified Minkowski, Bach, and BDF bounds; tighter preflight estimates and resumable progress; canonical authenticated records; and selective Dedekind--Kummer construction that builds only eligible residue degrees. The discriminant-380452 quintic factor base fell from 10.98s to 1.76s and repeated construction to 20 microseconds while retaining norm order and differential equality with the full certified decomposition.
risks: The mandatory arithmetic-algebra pnpm test:native gate is intentionally pending for central integration; focused runtime, standalone Pyright, and strict-baselib receipts pass.

The selective path uses established internal Dedekind--Kummer constructors from prime_ideals.py because this lane cannot change the shared prime-ideal API; a later integration-owned public selective constructor should replace that private coupling.
Exact BDF evaluation is deliberately capped and optimized for rigorous planning rather than bulk repeated calls; maximal-order identity caching avoids repeat work in one context.
next_steps: Integration should connect FactorBasePlan and FactorBasePrimeRecord.to_dict() to ClassUnitGroupContext.set_factor_base().
Integration owns the pending pnpm test:native and broad build/precompile gates.
Promote the selective p-maximal constructor into the shared prime-ideal API when that integration-owned surface next changes; the canonical record schema needs no migration.
